description: This file defines the interface for a JSON-RPC client library used in a hardware abstraction layer (HAL). It declares functions for initializing, running, sending requests, subscribing to events, and cleaning up, along with type definitions, macros, and constants related to JSON-RPC communication with a server.

methods.name: json_hal_client_init
methods.description: Initializes the HAL client with a specified configuration file.

methods.name: json_hal_client_send_and_get_reply
methods.description: Sends a request and waits synchronously for a response.

methods.name: json_hal_client_send_and_get_reply_with_timeout
methods.description: Sends a request and waits for a response with a specified timeout.

methods.name: json_hal_client_get_request_header
methods.description: Creates a JSON header message containing module, version, action, and sequence ID.

methods.name: json_hal_client_subscribe_event
methods.description: Registers a callback to notify when a specific event occurs.

methods.name: json_hal_client_terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and finalizes the client library.

methods.name: json_hal_is_client_connected
methods.description: Checks if the client successfully connected to the server.

methods.name: json_hal_get_result_status
methods.description: Parses a JSON message to determine if it indicates success.

methods.name: json_hal_get_total_param_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of parameters embedded in a JSON message.

ctags.name: event_callback
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*event_callback) (const char* event_msg, const int event_msg_length);$/
